data.gender_notes: Rampravesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram- the name of God, Pravesh- entrance, abode, or dwelling place, hence Rampravesh means the abode or dwelling place of God. The name Rampravesh carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rampravesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that connects one to God and provides strength and courage in times of need.
data.etymology: Rampravesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rampravesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rampravesh holds significant cultural importance, as it brings to mind the legendary character 'Ram' from the epic Hindu text Ramayana. Ram, as depicted in the scripture, is an embodiment of virtue, righteousness, and self-discipline, representing the ideal son, husband, and king. The name Rampravesh can thus be seen as invoking the spirit of this beloved deity and his virtuous way of life, thereby connecting the bearer to the rich Hindu cultural heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: At a deeper spiritual level, the name Rampravesh holds immense significance as it is a constant reminder of the divine presence in one's life. The word 'Pravesh' refers to entry or dwelling place, implying that the divine being Ram has made his dwelling in the bearer of the name. It is believed that by embracing this name, one's inner self is infused with the divine qualities of Ram and grants inner peace and tranquility. It is also a source of inspiration, pushing the bearer to live a virtuous and righteous life, just as Ram did.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rampravesh: In the divine name Rampravesh, 'Ram' symbolizes the supreme soul or God, and 'Pravesh' represents the entry or invocation of God within one's heart and soul. This name signifies the deep longing and call to experience the divine presence within.

historical_references.reference: Rampravesh was a prominent Hindu leader from the Jat community who actively participated in the Indian independence movement. He was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and was involved in various satyagraha movements. He was born on January 1, 1885, in the village of Bibipur, Hissar district, Punjab.

Rampravesh was a prominent Hindu leader from the Jat community who made significant contributions to the Indian freedom struggle during the British Raj. He was a member of the Indian National Congress and served as the President of the Punjab Provincial Congress Committee. He was born in 1886 in the village of Jandiala, Jalandhar district, Punjab.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Rampravesh continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
